## Checklist

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings

### Testing
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix/feature works
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] I have updated test documentation if applicable

### Documentation
- [ ] I have updated documentation accordingly
- [ ] I have updated the changelog if applicable
- [ ] Any new features are documented

### Linting & Formatting
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes with no errors
- [ ] `black --check .` passes with no errors
- [ ] `mypy .` passes with no errors

### Security & Privacy
- [ ] I have reviewed my changes for security vulnerabilities
- [ ] I have not introduced any hardcoded secrets or credentials
- [ ] No sensitive data is logged or exposed
- [ ] Input validation is applied where needed

### Accessibility
- [ ] UI changes are accessible (screen readers, keyboard navigation)
- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards
- [ ] All interactive elements are keyboard accessible
